caption: Tempio Malatestiano, Rimini
composition: Alberti unfinished Renaissance marble temple facade on Piazza Malatesta · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The viewpoint is from the piazza in front of the Tempio Malatestiano at midday, facing the unfinished marble facade. The three great arches of Alberti's front stand at the center, flanked by the curved side bays, with the raw uncompleted attic block rising plainly above the pediment. The modelled 23 September 2026, 11:50 light is bright and even under a pale blue sky, the white marble almost luminous against the dark paving of the square.
